admission: proved prime p and full group order r; r!=p; ordinary; j not 0,1728; embedding degree >64
base_matching: entire multiplicative coset; other bases match its actual number of canonical +/- point classes; no truncation of coset
digit_base: 8 balanced radix digits; radix 4, 8, 8 at 16,20,24 bits; digits -2..2; support size then L1 then seeded hash; deduplicate modulo p
target_sampling: same independent uniform signed finite points for all four bases, outside the union of the four signed bases; no scalar labels
decomposition: three distinct canonical point classes, arbitrary signs; all generic decompositions retained, first eight used for homogeneous cycles
rank: fixed factor-base columns; subtract two decompositions of the same fixed target; exact arithmetic modulo proved prime r
generic_method: sorted native signed pair table and exact third-point joins; all setup, target failures, verification and rank work charged
algebraic_method: hybrid outer point enumeration; inner two-point decomposition by a quadratic-algebra norm and polynomial gcd; coset membership evaluated by repeated squaring
gate_stop: stop algebraic scaling at first failing size; generic base comparison still completes at all sizes
fresh_cpu_cap: same per-target cap as gate; include timeouts and charge full setup and rank work
primary_endpoint: 24-bit independent homogeneous rank per total CPU second; exact join comparison of all four bases; fresh algebraic comparison only if gate passes
inference: 10000 bootstrap resamples of entire fields, preserving curves, base seeds and target pairing; 95% descriptive intervals, no familywise discovery claim
limits: bounded pilot, not powered to establish a 15% effect; no point logarithm recovery; no claim about NIST-size complexity
